name: dr-performance-platform
description: Plataforma de acompanhamento da assessoria DR Performance.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run dev -w @dr-performance/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run dev -w @dr-performance/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run build -w @dr-performance/api && npm run build -w @dr-performance/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run build -w @dr-performance/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run build -w @dr-performance/api
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @dr-performance/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
